entities.summary: Hunter Shinkaruk is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward who is currently a free agent. He last played with the Elite Ice Hockey League (EIHL)'s Cardiff Devils. He was selected in the first round, 24th overall, by the Vancouver Canucks of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2013 NHL Entry Draft, and has also played for the Calgary Flames.
